features.name: Microsoft Talent Program
features.description: A reskilling program by Microsoft that recruits individuals from industry and retrains them to become Business Central professionals, consultants, or developers to address the talent gap in the ARP sector.

features.name: Theory and practice learning mix
features.description: The talent program combines theoretical knowledge with practical application as a method for reskilling individuals into Business Central consultants.
